variables.stuck: {% set ns = namespace(l=[]) %}{% if states('switch.magic_areas_light_groups_' ~ area ~ '_light_control') == 'on' and states('binary_sensor.magic_areas_presence_tracking_' ~ area ~ '_area_state') == 'off' %}{% for s in expand('light.magic_areas_light_groups_' ~ area ~ '_all_lights') %}{% if s.state == 'on' and as_timestamp(s.last_changed) < as_timestamp(trigger.to_state.last_changed) %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + [s.entity_id] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% endif %}{{ ns.l }}

data.message: sent OFF again to {{ stuck | join(', ') }}: still on 90 s after {{ area }} cleared
data.name: Lights retry

alias: Lights — retry an OFF that did not take
description: Magic Areas turns every light off when a room clears. A light still on 90 s later that has not changed since the room cleared is a failed Zigbee OFF or a wrong state in HA (2026-10-25: MA then skipped the next turn-on). Send OFF once more. Unreachable bulbs and paused rooms are left alone; no notification.
